lead.headline: McLaurin's knee is feared season-ending — claim Metcalf and fix three bye-week holes
lead.deck: Week 6 won 122.6 to 82.94 with 11.0 on the bench; as set, Week 7 starts two players on bye.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Terry McLaurin was carted off in an air cast Monday night at San Francisco; Washington fear a season-ending knee injury and the MRI is today. Chem has no IR slot. Week 6 was still a win, 122.6 to 82.94 over Bok-aneers, with 11.0 left on the bench — Kamara's 14.9 behind Allgeier's 5.8 and Love's 20.2 behind Allen's 18.3, both projection calls. AVIATO are 2-4. For Week 7 the lineup as set projects 86.6 against a projection lineup of 129.5: Love for Allen, Gordon for Tuten, Jefferson back in. Claim DK Metcalf, Pittsburgh's 15-target WR1, before 01:00 and drop McLaurin.

doFirst.headline: One claim tonight, three swaps before Sunday
doFirst.deck: Claim Metcalf for McLaurin before 01:00 CDMX; then Love, Gordon and Jefferson into the lineup.
doFirst.note: Hold the Patriots D/ST and Fairbairn: the D/ST seat changed six days ago and the kicker ties the best available.
doFirst.empty: Nothing left to decide — the lineup is the projection lineup.

cards.headline: Claim DK Metcalf, drop McLaurin
cards.reason: McLaurin's knee is feared season-ending (Yahoo 20 Oct) and Chem has no IR slot. Metcalf drew 15 targets in Week 6. Cancel only if the MRI comes back short-term before 01:00.

cards.headline: Week 7: Allen and Tuten are off — set three swaps
cards.reason: Buffalo and Jacksonville are on bye. Love starts at quarterback, Gordon in Tuten's RB slot, and Jefferson returns with Garrett Wilson in the flex; Allgeier sits.

roster.deck: The lineup as set is 42.9 below the projection lineup: Allen and Tuten are on bye and Jefferson is benched.

wire.headline: Claim Metcalf; Mayer is next week's tight end
wire.deck: Metcalf's role is Pittsburgh's WR1, not a vacancy. Everything else on the screen is someone else's injury.

4262921.deck: Back from the bye; starts over Allgeier.
4262921.reason: Murray the incumbent; Addison and Hockenson may return
4262921.availability: ACTIVE — no current injury listed (Athlon 19 Oct); Minnesota off a Week 6 bye
4262921.competition: Jordan Addison (hamstring) expected back, O'Connell: 'we almost got him there' (Heavy 11-12 Oct); T.J. Hockenson in concussion protocol, team hopes for Week 7 (Rotowire 13 Oct). RIVAL_QUESTIONABLE answered: if both return his share falls back toward Weeks 1-2, not below WR1
4262921.passer: Kyler Murray, the incumbent since Week 3 (CBS/Rotowire log); not yet named for Week 7. QB_CHANGE answered: the tool's 'J.J. McCarthy' is stale — ESPN now lists McCarthy with the Giants
4262921.checked: Heavy 11-12 Oct, Rotowire 13 Oct, Athlon 19 Oct, CBS/Rotowire QB log — Minnesota's first Week 7 report is Wednesday

vsProjection.text: Addison and Hockenson's timelines broke 11-13 Oct; the 18.6 was set after.

4262921.logic: 18.6 against Allgeier's 7.3 in the flex chain — an 11.3 gap, not close. Indianapolis rank 13th against receivers. Changes only if Minnesota name a quarterback other than Murray.

4569618.deck: Starts into the second-toughest receiver matchup.

4569618.competition: Omar Cooper Jr. back from IR (ankle): 6 for 102 and a 48-yard TD; Geno Smith called him 'a playmaker' (NewYorkJets.com, Yahoo 19 Oct). A second outlet for the targets
4569618.checked: NBC 18 Oct, NewYorkJets.com 19 Oct, Yahoo 19 Oct

vsProjection.text: Cooper's return came in Week 6, before Tuesday's numbers. Believe the 15.1.

4569618.logic: 15.1 against the next receiver, Metcalf at 14.9 on the wire — a coin flip, so the projection keeps him. Miami 2nd vs WR. Cooper's 37% share in Week 6 is the thing to watch, not a reason to sit him.

4569987.deck: Lead back in Paris against the softest run defence.
4569987.reason: New Orleans allow the most RB points; Dowdle takes a third
4569987.availability: ACTIVE — no injury reported after Week 6 (Athlon 19 Oct)
4569987.role: 14 carries and 4 targets in Week 6 against a stacked Tampa Bay box (Athlon 19 Oct; archive)
4569987.competition: Rico Dowdle back from a toe injury that cost him three games: 7 carries for 40 (Athlon 18 Oct). McCarthy said Dowdle may be used to manage Warren's workload (Yahoo 12 Oct). ROLE_UP answered: Warren's 100% in Weeks 3-5 was Dowdle's absence; with Dowdle back it is 67% — the trend is down, not up
4569987.passer: Aaron Rodgers, no injury reported (Athlon 19 Oct)
4569987.checked: Steelers Week 6 coverage (CBS 18 Oct, Athlon 18-19 Oct, Yahoo 12 Oct); no Week 7 report issued yet

vsProjection.text: Dowdle returned in Week 6, before Tuesday's projection; 17.8 already carries the split.

4569987.logic: 17.8, the highest back on the roster by 6.0 — no decision. Dowdle's return is priced. Changes only on a Wednesday-Friday practice listing.

4361050.logic: 14.3, the only tight end on the roster. Houston rank 11th against tight ends; the Giants' implied total is 17 (Covers 20 Oct). Changes only if he is hurt — no tight end on the bench.
